value.body: A BBA track on the travel business — tour operations and itinerary planning, travel agency management, airline ticketing, destination knowledge, hospitality basics and tourism marketing. A related named degree is the Bachelor of Tourism and Travel Management (BTTM).

items.label: Regulator
items.note: Alongside the affiliating university; BBA, BCA and BMS were brought under AICTE from 2024-25

items.label: Domestic tourist visits
items.note: Visits, not unique travellers; calendar year 2024

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 in any stream. Admission is by Class 12 marks, CUET-UG, or a university's own test. Some universities offer the specialisation from the start as a named programme; others let you choose it in the second or third year.

value.title: At a glance
items: Work is in travel agencies, tour operators, online travel companies and hotels; peak seasons bring long hours.
Travel demand rises and falls with seasons, the economy and disruptions such as the 2020–21 pandemic.
Ticketing (GDS) training, a foreign language and destination knowledge are useful additions.
Common next steps: an MTTM or an MBA.

value.title: Foreign tourist arrivals in India
value.note: Earlier provisional figures were lower (about 61.9 lakh for 2022 and 92.4 lakh for 2023). Shows demand in the sector, not jobs or hiring for graduates of this course.
value.source: Ministry of Tourism, Lok Sabha reply (Aug 2025), based on Bureau of Immigration data (as reported)
